description: Independent ground-truth corpus for dynamicState C++ runtime investigation quality evaluation

scenarios.description: Clean deterministic state transition via verified causal writer transition_worker_state
scenarios.field_invariant: worker_status must follow valid WorkerStatus enum transitions (STATUS_INITIALIZING=1 -> STATUS_RUNNING=2)
scenarios.causal_ground_truth: transition_worker_state is the authentic causal writer function in the binary
scenarios.sufficient_evidence_for_attribution: Authentic runtime execution trace or controlled single-writer isolation proving transition_worker_state executed and wrote worker_status; snapshot diff and static symbol existence alone are insufficient

scenarios.description: epoch_id updated without corresponding cached_epoch update creating invariant drift
scenarios.field_invariant: epoch_id must equal cached_epoch in synchronized state; divergence indicates stale cache
scenarios.exact_mutation_source: update_epoch_partial(10) in fixture_target.cpp updates epoch_id but omits cached_epoch
scenarios.expected_observable_state: g_target.epoch_id changes from 1 to 10 while g_target.cached_epoch remains 1
scenarios.causal_ground_truth: update_epoch_partial is the partial writer causing invariant drift, but cached_epoch has no writer
scenarios.sufficient_evidence_for_attribution: Independent execution trace showing update_epoch_partial wrote epoch_id but omitted cached_epoch

scenarios.description: device_mode set to undefined enum value 999 outside defined range [0, 2]
scenarios.field_invariant: device_mode must be one of MODE_IDLE (0), MODE_ACTIVE (1), MODE_STANDBY (2)
scenarios.exact_mutation_source: set_illegal_device_mode(999) in fixture_target.cpp writes illegal integer 999
scenarios.expected_observable_state: g_target.device_mode changes from 0 to out-of-range value 999
scenarios.causal_ground_truth: set_illegal_device_mode is the causal function writing illegal value
scenarios.sufficient_evidence_for_attribution: Execution trace attributing write of illegal value 999 to set_illegal_device_mode

scenarios.field_invariant: When buffer_size > 0, data_ptr must be a valid non-null memory address
scenarios.exact_mutation_source: allocate_invalid_buffer(4096) in fixture_target.cpp sets buffer_size without allocating data_ptr
scenarios.expected_observable_state: g_target.buffer_size changes from 0 to 4096 while g_target.data_ptr remains null (0x0)
scenarios.causal_ground_truth: allocate_invalid_buffer is the causal function setting size without allocation
scenarios.sufficient_evidence_for_attribution: Execution trace attributing buffer_size write without pointer allocation to allocate_invalid_buffer

scenarios.description: Competing unsynchronized thread writers without atomicity guarantee; causal promotion must be blocked
scenarios.field_invariant: unsynchronized_metric writes must be serialized; concurrent unsynchronized writes create non-atomic race
scenarios.exact_mutation_source: Concurrent competing threads running competing_writer_a and competing_writer_b in fixture_target.cpp
scenarios.expected_observable_state: g_target.unsynchronized_metric mutates continuously between non-atomic captures
scenarios.causal_ground_truth: Ambiguous multi-writer race; neither writer can be singled out as sole causal writer
scenarios.sufficient_evidence_for_attribution: Cannot be validated as single causal function; capture quality is NON_ATOMIC which strictly blocks causal promotion

scenarios.description: Field mutated via harness command dispatcher; no dedicated domain causal function in binary and candidate unrelated_helper_function has no causal relationship
scenarios.field_invariant: unassociated_field must not be attributed to unrelated domain functions
scenarios.exact_mutation_source: Harness command dispatcher modifying unassociated_field; candidate unrelated_helper_function never writes it
scenarios.causal_ground_truth: No candidate domain function in binary caused this state change; unrelated_helper_function is strictly non-causal
scenarios.sufficient_evidence_for_attribution: Requires verified trace or single-writer isolation which cannot exist for unrelated_helper_function
